complete_examples.text: Affected by the tectonic activity of the active fault zone, the tunnel inverted arch and track structure are prone to deformation following the dislocation of foundation, which is unfavourable to the normal operation of the line [4,5].
The interactions between SCC and concrete base, concrete base and inverted arch are set to be ‘surface to surface contact’ with friction coefficients of 0.8 and 0.5, respectively [43].
